_doc: The ONE list of what can be lifted (design/RimMandrake/salvage_lift_policy_2026-11-01.md). Ordered rules: first match wins. A match clause is all-of its fields; a category matches on any clause. Category rules, not a curated def list (owner, 2026-08-31, trap_renaissance_spec.md 2b: 'The scope is a CATEGORY, not a list'). defName fields only seed what no structural field can name. The policy only ADDS: a def that declares its own minifiedDef keeps it. Verdicts are taken on the defs as authored, before any write. thingClass_base means 'is or derives from': the game tests assignability; the census approximates by name prefix. grants are building fields the pass switches on so the route can actually run.

categories.why: rock and ore; not a building anyone lifts
the nine fixtures the ship loop needs (convenience_replacements.md 1.3 b2); own gear, never degraded
WreckedMachines tier 1: no colonist moves it (DESIGN.md 1), but 'a stolen wreck is low heat' (wrecked_machines_resurrection.md)
our wreck families strip through the Deconstruct designation; nothing reinstalls (jawa_scavenge_system_design 2c)
owner 2026-08-31: 'We can steal their traps rather than setting them off'; lifted intact (2b); a Jawa adds the disarm-and-take verb
owner 2026-08-31: 'maybe also their sandbags, anti-tank traps, fences, etc.'
owner 2026-08-31: 'yes to unstable fuel nodes and other unconventional trap nodes'; redeployed as OUR hazard
already minifiable: vanilla's own set plus our explicit minifiedDefs; camp gear and furniture lift as they are
hull moves with the ship; walls, doors, conduits, vents and gravship parts stay out (convenience_replacements.md 1.3 b, 4)
leaving big kit behind is the decision the ship loop is built on (1.3 b): scanners, and anything of 10 cells or more
a marked spot, a grave or a fire: nothing to carry
owner 2026-08-31: 'A hauler droid that can steal buildings is a fantastic idea'; only the droid lifts these, colonists scrap them
the owner's 'big, nasty, complex pieces of tech': vanilla forbids deconstructing ancient vehicles and war machines; a Jawa strips them, never lifts them
ancient set dressing vanilla marks non-deconstructible: blast doors, cranes, drill platforms, quest pods; the map's bones stay
ruin furniture, broken ancient guns and hulks: scrap for yield, no crates of rust
quest, entity, archotech and mech-cluster objects: the policy changes nothing
